changes.comment: **Breaking.** Rework the token layer into primitives, semantic roles and component locals. Thirty-eight `--yl-*` properties are renamed; `scripts/token-rename-map.json` is the full map and `scripts/codemod-tokens.mjs` applies it. The emitter now walks the token objects exhaustively instead of naming each property, which brings the twelve-style type scale, `motion.duration.slow`, two easings and the full interactive role set into CSS for the first time: 160 properties where there were 86. Brand-coloured text and button fills move from `primary[500]` to `primary[600]`, fixing a 4.06:1 contrast failure that affected every primary button label, and `tests/contrast.test.ts` now computes every pairing in both themes. No component name appears in the global token namespace any more: `btn` became `interactive`, `ghost` became `interactive-quiet`, and `code` became the `ink` surface.
